changelog: New spoken punctuation: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'open single quote' / 'close single quote' (or 'একক উদ্ধৃতি শুরু' / 'একক উদ্ধৃতি শেষ') while dictating and single quotes ‘ ’ appear — for a quote inside a quote in a dictated story ('he said open quote she said open single quote I will go close single quote close quote' → he said “she said ‘I will go’”) instead of typing them by hand. The double quotes and the apostrophe work exactly as before. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
